method: Dedicated worker per library; ten warmups; 100 single-input samples; fixed repeated four-input batches. Timings cover public parse calls, including gpu-time-vi date resolution and recurrence previews, excluding worker messaging and DOM. regex-vi is a hand-written floor with a fraction of the coverage, so its timings are not comparable feature for feature.
